content.value: Write an assembly language program in 8086 that reads the temperature of cleaning bath solution and lights one of the two lamps according to temperature read. If the temperature is <30°C, a yellow lamp will be turned on. If the temperature is ≥ 30°C, a green lamp will be turned on.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
